user.title: Connect AB Vassilopoulos
user.description:
Use **one** browser (Edge or Firefox, not both). Cookie values differ per browser because each has its own login session — either works if you are signed in on the Greek site (ab.gr).

1. Open [{login_url}]({login_url}) and sign in.
2. Enable **Keep me signed in / Remember me** on the login form.
3. Press F12 → **Network**.
4. Press F5.
5. Filter `api/v1` → click the first row.
6. **Headers** → **Request Headers** → **Cookie** (not Set-Cookie).
7. Right-click → Copy value.
8. Paste into the box below.

data_description.cookie_header: A long line like name=value; name2=value2; …  Not a URL and not your password.
